continuity.campaign_development: December 60 BCE: Valerius continued beyond the hard pass, secured a hidden store, reorganized the column, and crossed a river at the Ford of Three Fires after scouts found signs of recent watchers. A previously unrecorded settlement was identified beyond the ford. The ravine fortress remains in Roman hands and its road remains open.
